title: Help & Support
subtitle: What this app does, and how to reach a person

about.title: What GWPrintz is
about.body: GWPrintz fulfills personalized products. You send orders in; we print, pack, QC and ship them. This dashboard is where you watch that happen and sort out anything that goes wrong.

contact.title: Need a person?
contact.body: Raise a ticket. It is the supported way to reach support, and it keeps the whole conversation attached to the order.
contact.note: Support answers on the ticket itself, so there is no second inbox to watch.

guide.title: Where things live
guide.subtitle: Every area of the dashboard, in one list.

orders.title: Orders
orders.body: Every order from checkout to delivery, with its production and shipping status.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.body: What is on the shelves — materials and finished goods.

fulfillment.title: Fulfillment
fulfillment.body: The production floor: scanning, labels and tracking.

tickets.title: Support
tickets.body: Your tickets, and everything support has replied.

before.title: Before you open a ticket
before.subtitle: A ticket carrying these three things gets answered on the first reply.
before.s1: The Order ID, exactly as it appears in the orders table.
before.s2: What you expected to happen, and what happened instead.
before.s3: A screenshot or the artwork file, if the problem is visual.
